description:
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Front Turn Light Assemblies.
Features the change from Amber Running Light Lens to Clear Running Light Lens to give a Fog Light Effect.
Both Sides
Suzuki OEM, Boxed as Lumax
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Front Turn Light Assembly – Driver
Qty 1 – Front Turn Light Assembly – Passenger
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
